concept.hr: DNS seli korisnike; sjednice i licencije vezane uz stroj ostaju iza
concept.en: DNS/GSLB moves users; sessions and machine-bound licences stay behind

summary.hr: Lokacija A pada, zapis se mijenja na B, korisnici prelaze tek kad im istekne TTL. Sjednice i licencija vezana uz stroj ne prelaze; povratak traži kopiju B → A.
summary.en: Site A fails, the record moves to B, users follow only as their TTL expires. Sessions and a machine-bound licence stay behind; failing back needs a copy B → A.

concept.hr: Tri neuspjele provjere, zapis na B u 30. s, svi korisnici na B do 330. s
concept.en: Three failed checks, the record on B at 30 s, every user on B by 330 s

concept.hr: Čovjek odlučuje 30 min: zapis u 14:35, najgori slučaj 14:40
concept.en: A person takes 30 min: the record at 14:35, worst case 14:40

concept.hr: TTL 3600 s: mrtva adresa ostaje u predmemoriji sat vremena nakon promjene
concept.en: TTL 3600 s: the dead address stays cached for an hour after the change

concept.hr: Svi su na B, a licencirani rad stoji: licencija je vezana uz stroj na A
concept.en: Everyone is on B, the licensed work stops: the licence is bound to A's machine

concept.hr: Prvo kopija B → A, zatim zapis; bez kopije zapisi s B nestaju
concept.en: Copy B → A first, then the record; without the copy B's writes are lost
